chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Hammad, from Ibn Sukan, from Mushamil ibn Sa'd, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who leaves behind his two parents, he said: 'It is from three shares; for the mother one share and for the father two shares.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of parents when both are alive?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific division of the estate when a deceased leaves both parents, assigning one-third to the mother and two-thirds to the father. This ruling reflects the Quranic principle of the father's role as the primary guardian and provider, distinguishing his share from the mother's fixed portion. It serves as a foundational text in Shia jurisprudence for calculating parental inheritance in the absence of other competing heirs.
